title: MeterFrame
description: One batched metering frame, pushed over the Tauri Channel passed to subscribe_meters at ~60 Hz (one frame per tick containing ALL tracks). Values aggregate the interval since the previous frame. Mirrors Rust struct audio::MeterFrame.

seq.description: Monotonic frame counter, per subscription, starting at 0. Gaps indicate dropped frames (UI may ignore).

positionSamples.description: Engine playhead position (samples at the project sample rate) when this frame was captured.

tracks.description: Per-track meters, one entry per existing track (order unspecified; match by trackId).

drivenParams.description: Plugin params the engine's automation driver is holding right now, with the value it last wrote to the host. Plugin-param automation is host-only (Track D ruling 2), so this read-back is the only thing that says what a parameter is actually doing; the document keeps whatever the user set. Empty whenever the transport is stopped, nothing is automated, or a rebuild has just replaced the driver — which is also how a UI knows to stop following. Display state: nothing persists it.

instanceId.description: Plugin instance id — what plugin_get_params and plugin_set_param address.

index.description: Host parameter index, the same id plugin_get_params reports.

value.description: Value in the parameter's native host units (same units as PluginParamInfo.value).

trackId.description: Track UUID, or the literal "master" for the master bus.

peakL.description: Maximum absolute sample value (linear, full scale = 1.0; may exceed 1.0 when clipping) on the left channel over the frame interval. Convert to dBFS with 20*log10(x).

peakR.description: Peak, right channel (same units as peakL). Mono tracks mirror peakL.

rmsL.description: Root-mean-square level (linear, full scale = 1.0) on the left channel over the frame interval.

clipped.description: True if any sample in the interval reached/exceeded full scale.
